claim_text: As of October 1, 2026, USAO-MN identified Abdi Nur Salah as the 31st Feeding Our Future defendant sentenced after he received a 33-month prison sentence.

supporting_passages.quote: USAO-MN states that Salah is the 31st defendant sentenced in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme.
supporting_passages.locator: press release body, St. Paul Man Sentenced to 33 Months’ Imprisonment...

qualifiers: This is an official DOJ ordinal milestone stated outright by the source, not a value derived by this corpus through addition, subtraction, or roster reconciliation.

Charged, convicted, and sentenced are overlapping procedural stages of the same population, not additive groups; do not sum or subtract this value against the charged or convicted metrics to infer a 'pending' count.
This supersedes the previously published 26th-defendant sentencing milestone from August 27, 2026 because USAO-MN explicitly states the newer 31st-defendant ordinal.
This claim covers only the Feeding Our Future investigation; it does not include Housing Stabilization Services or any other program.
public_explanation: DOJ identified Abdi Nur Salah as the 31st Feeding Our Future defendant sentenced after he received 33 months in prison.
